description: The image displays two pie charts comparing error and success distributions across four categories—“Atomic Skill Fail,” “Correct,” “Reason Error,” and “Question Misunderstood”—as defined in the legend at the top. Both charts use percentage labels inside each slice and are visually structured to emphasize the relative proportions of each error or success type, likely illustrating performance differences under varying conditions or task complexities as explored in the paper “Laying the Foundation First: Investigating the Generalization from Atomic Skills to Complex Reasoning Tasks.”
